verses.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!

xrefs.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

verses.text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

xrefs.text: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.
When Jesus said, “I am He, they drew back and fell to the ground.
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.

verses.text: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.

xrefs.text: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
Do not gloat when your enemy falls, and do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles,
(Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.

Tell the Ammonites to hear the word of the Lord GOD, for this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you exclaimed, “Aha!” when My sanctuary was profaned, when the land of Israel was laid waste, and when the house of Judah went into exile,
Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”

verses.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”

xrefs.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”

verses.text: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.

xrefs.text: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon. Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
